## 3. Camping Cave — best pet-friendly Pilzone alternative

**Location:** Via Cave 13, Pilzone d’Iseo (municipality of Iseo, BS)  
**Official website / booking:** <https://www.campingcave.it/en/>  
**2026 season:** 30 April–4 October

Cave has a grassy lakeside setting, shade and a more traditional campsite feel. Its standard pitch is about **7.0 × 6.5 m**, includes **4A electricity**, and recent booking-site reviews rate the scenery, staff and restaurant highly.

Peak 2026 prices mirror Pilzone closely: **€25 standard, €30 lake zone, €34 first row**, plus **€13 per adult**. For two adults, a first-row pitch is roughly **€60 before tourist tax**. Pets are allowed.

Lagovivo at Via Cave 1 is nearby for SUP rental. A practical caution from recent camper reviews is that access can feel narrow and pitches are not particularly large, so this is less attractive for very large motorhomes.


**2 September booking note:** No dependable public date-specific pitch inventory is exposed; check the booking channel or contact the site directly. Published pricing is in the comparison table above.

**Official tariff:** <https://www.campingcave.it/listino-prezzi/>

**Best for:** pets, shade, quieter/simple camping, nearby SUP rental.  
**Downside:** 4A electrical supply, modest pitch size, tighter access than some Iseo-town sites.

---

## 4. Sassabanek — best large leisure complex and ACSI option

**Location:** Via Colombera 2, Iseo  
**Official website / booking:** <https://www.sassabanek.com/en/>  
**2026 season:** 1 April–4 October

Sassabanek is a large complex rather than an intimate waterside campground. It combines Caravan Camping with the Sporting Lido, pools, sports facilities, restaurants and a marina. For SUP users, the key point is that its 2026 material explicitly advertises **SUP and kayak rental** through Sporting Lido/ATLS. The Sporting Lido is scheduled to remain open through **6 September 2026**, so it is operational for a 2 September arrival.

For 2 September, keep three separate price mechanisms distinct:

- **Regular tariff:** 23 August–20 September is the normal middle band: **€21.50 standard pitch / €25.50 large pitch + €11.50 per adult**, before tourist tax. €21.50 is a regular tariff, not itself a special offer.
- **September promotion:** from 1 September, stays of **5+ nights** receive **10% off the pitch component**.
- **ACSI:** the separate ACSI offer starts **6 September** and is advertised from €25/day per qualifying pitch. It does not help for the first nights of a 2 September arrival unless Sassabanek confirms that it can be applied part-way through the stay.

**2 September booking note:** Sassabanek is actively marketing September stays, but that does not prove a pitch is free on 2 September. Its separate September promotion starts on 1 September; ACSI does not begin until 6 September. See the consolidated comparison table above.

**September offer:** <https://www.sassabanek.com/it/fine-estate-lago-iseo>

**Best for:** facilities, families, low-season ACSI users, on-site water-sports access.  
**Downside:** less of the small, quiet “van parked almost in the lake” atmosphere that Covelo/Punta d’Oro/Pilzone provide.

---

## 5. Camping Eurovil — strong Predore all-rounder with on-site SUP rental

**Location:** Via San Giorgio 2, Predore  
**Official website / booking:** <https://campingeurovil.it/en/>  
**2026 season:** 27 March–27 September

Eurovil is one of the strongest alternatives outside the Iseo/Pilzone cluster. Its current official campsite page says it has **pitches of different sizes suitable for campers and minivans**, all with **6A electricity**, and that a **new camper area with lake view** opened for the 2026 season. The campsite describes itself as only a few metres from Lake Iseo; its services page is even more useful for this trip because it explicitly lists **SUP rental** and **lake access directly in front of the campsite**. The swimming pools are scheduled to remain open until **13 September 2026**, so they are operating for a 2 September arrival.

The nuance is that this is not quite the same proposition as a Punta d’Oro/Covelo first-row pitch physically touching the water. Eurovil's own wording is “a few metres from the lake” and “lake access in front”; the guide therefore avoids overstating every pitch as literal lakefront.

Rental resilience is nevertheless unusually good. In addition to Eurovil's own SUP service, **Whassup Rental** operates in Predore at Via Roma 3 with online reservations, hourly/full-day rentals and guided/sunset outings. Its current tariff is **€15/1h, €20/1.5h, €25/2h, €40/half-day or €50/full day**, including board, paddle, leash, dry bag and life jacket. That gives Predore a useful second rental channel if the campsite's own boards are busy.

**2 September booking note:** the campsite is open and its booking system is active, but I could not obtain a reliable public touring-pitch tariff or date-specific camper inventory for 2 September. Contact it directly rather than reading mobile-home availability as pitch availability.

**Best for:** renters who want redundancy, medium campers, facilities/pool, a quieter southwestern base near Sarnico/Predore.  
**Downside:** public touring-pitch pricing is less transparent than Pilzone/Olivella; exact SUP fleet size and equipment-reservation rules are not published.
